items.title: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE (StyleSmuggler) under active attack
items.summary: Sansec discovered a zero-day vulnerability allowing unauthenticated attackers remote code execution, with attacks starting September 4th. Adobe published an emergency hotfix on September 7th for this critical vulnerability, rated CVSS 10.0, affecting versions 2.4.4 up to and including 2.4.9.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Adobe released a critical security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source to resolve a critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-75650) that could result in arbitrary code execution. Adobe is aware of this CVE being exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Adobe released a regularly scheduled security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, resolving critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability leading to Privilege Escalation
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account and escalate privileges without requiring administrator access. This vulnerability has been observed being exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Adobe released a security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, resolving critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including an unauthenticated customer account takeover (CVE-2026-71362) with a CVSS score of 9.1.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges for exploitation.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Adobe Commerce B2B)
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring neither authentication nor administrator privileges for exploitation.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication and administrator privileges for exploitation.

items.title: Critical Remote Code Execution Vulnerabilities in Amasty Extensions
items.summary: Amasty issued a massive security release for dozens of extensions, including two critical vulnerabilities that can lead to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, opening the door to remote code execution.

items.title: Critical Unauthenticated PHP Object Injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer
items.summary: Sansec found an unauthenticated PHP object injection flaw in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a popular Magento full-page cache extension.

items.title: Unrestricted File Upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce (PolyShell)
items.summary: A critical flaw in Magento's REST API allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files to any store using a polyglot technique. Adobe released Magento 2.4.9 containing the fix on May 12, 2026, but older supported versions remain vulnerable without backported fixes.
